title: Chris Cuomo GRILLS Todd Blanche Over Epstein Files LIVE on NewsNation
description:
When a top Justice Department official sits down for a live interview and the host refuses to accept a single rehearsed answer, you get one of the more revealing exchanges in recent political television. This video breaks down the full back-and-forth between the interviewer and the Deputy Attorney General on NewsNation, where the conversation centers on how the Justice Department handled the release of a set of heavily redacted federal files and whether the public is getting the full picture.

The heart of this discussion is transparency. Congress passed a law compelling the release of these documents, but a large portion of what reached the public arrived blacked out. The official's position is that those redactions exist to protect the identities of victims, and that judges specifically ordered names withheld. The counter-position, pushed hard by the host, is that too much was hidden, that the people at the top cannot explain their own colleagues' earlier public claims, and that the resources poured into this one operation raise fair questions about what is actually being managed behind the scenes.

Throughout the interview you will see a familiar pattern play out. A clean, direct question gets met with a confident denial, and moments later that same denial quietly gets walked back. The host stays calm, never raises his voice, and simply keeps asking the same fair question until the answers begin to thin out. It is a masterclass in how a skilled communicator can talk in cir
